12: const addDateDays = (dateText, days) => {
13:   const date = new Date(`${dateText || dateKey(today)}T12:00:00`);
14:   if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return "";
15:   date.setDate(date.getDate() + Number(days || 0));
16:   return dateKey(date);
17: };
18: const daysFromToday = (dateText) => {
19:   const due = new Date(`${dateText}T12:00:00`), now = new Date(`${dateKey(today)}T12:00:00`);
20:   return Number.isNaN(due.getTime()) ? null : Math.round((due-now)/86400000);
21: };

190: function uepDiagSafe(value,depth=0){
191:   if(depth>6)return '[DEPTH_LIMIT]';
192:   if(value==null||typeof value==='number'||typeof value==='boolean')return value;
193:   if(typeof value==='string')return value.replace(/[A-Z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z]{2,}/gi,'[EMAIL_REDACTED]').slice(0,4000);
194:   if(Array.isArray(value))return value.slice(0,30).map(v=>uepDiagSafe(v,depth+1));
195:   if(typeof value==='object'){
196:     const out={};
197:     for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(value)){
198:       if(/token|secret|password|authorization|cookie|credential|private|email|name/i.test(k)){out[k]='[REDACTED]';continue;}
199:       out[k]=uepDiagSafe(v,depth+1);
200:     }
201:     return out;
202:   }
203:   return String(value);
204: }
205: function uepDiagRecord(stage,value){
206:   uepSchoolReadDiagnostics.push({at:new Date().toISOString(),stage,value:uepDiagSafe(value)});
207:   if(uepSchoolReadDiagnostics.length>80)uepSchoolReadDiagnostics.shift();
208: }

404: async function withStartupTimeout(promise, milliseconds, fallback = null) {
405:   let timer;
406:   try {
407:     return await Promise.race([
408:       Promise.resolve(promise),
409:       new Promise((resolve) => { timer = setTimeout(() => resolve(fallback), milliseconds); }),
410:     ]);
411:   } finally {
412:     if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
413:   }
414: }

840: function checkPeriodAlerts() {
841:   const setting = state.settings.widgetSettings.timetable || {};
842:   if (!setting.startAlert && !setting.endAlert) return;
843:   const now = new Date();
844:   const hhmm = `${String(now.getHours()).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2, "0")}`;
845:   const key = `${dateKey(now)}-${hhmm}`;
846:   if (key === lastPeriodAlertKey) return;
847:   for (const row of (state.settings.schoolHours || [])) {
848:     const name = row[0], start = row[1], end = row[2];
849:     let message = "";
850:     if (setting.startAlert && start === hhmm && String(name).includes("교시")) message = `${name} 수업이 시작됩니다.`;
851:     if (setting.endAlert && end === hhmm && String(name).includes("교시")) message = `${name} 수업이 종료됩니다.`;
852:     if (message) {
853:       lastPeriodAlertKey = key;
854:       toast(message);
855:       try { if ("Notification" in window && Notification.permission === "granted") new Notification("UEP 시간표 알림", { body: message }); } catch {}
856:       break;
857:     }
858:   }
859: }

936: async function sensitiveHash(value){
937:   const bytes=new TextEncoder().encode(`UEP:SENSITIVE:${String(value||'')}`);
938:   const digest=await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256',bytes);
939:   return Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest)).map(b=>b.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');
940: }

1665: function calendarEventTargetsFirstGrade(event) {
1666:   const target = String(event?.target || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
1667:   const detail = String(event?.detail || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").replace(/\(?1\s*[,·ㆍ&/]?\s*2?\s*학년부[^)]*\)?/g, " ");
1668:   if (/학부모/.test(target) && !/학생/.test(target)) return false;
1669:   if (/교사|교직원/.test(target) && !/학생/.test(target)) return false;
1670:   const text = target || detail;
1671:   return /(?:^|[^0-9])1\s*학년/.test(text)
1672:     || /1\s*[,·ㆍ&/]\s*2\s*학년/.test(text)
1673:     || /1\s*[~-]\s*3\s*학년/.test(text)

1871: function studentCounselCriteria(candidate,groupKey){

1873:   const actual=Number(base.actual9), hasActual=Number.isFinite(actual);
1874:   const internalLimit=groupKey==='seoul'?uepManagementRule('inseoul').internal:groupKey==='regional'?uepManagementRule('regional').internal:null;
1875:   let internal='bad';
1876:   const expandedGroup=hasActual?uepBaseManagementGroup(actual,base.avg5):'general';
1877:   const expandedOk=groupKey==='seoul'?expandedGroup==='inseoul':groupKey==='regional'?['inseoul','regional'].includes(expandedGroup):false;
1878:   if(internalLimit==null) internal=hasActual&&actual<=4.5?'near':'bad';
1879:   else if(expandedOk) internal='ok';
1880:   else if(hasActual&&actual<=internalLimit+0.35) internal='near';
1881:   const seoulMock=uepMockCoreFor('inseoul',mock);
1882:   const regionalMock=uepMockCoreFor('regional',mock);
1883:   let mockState=groupKey==='seoul'?(seoulMock?'ok':Number(mock.mainWithin2||0)>=1?'near':'bad'):
1884:     groupKey==='regional'?(regionalMock?'ok':Number(mock.mainWithin4||0)>=1?'near':'bad'):
1885:     (mock.levels?.length?(Number(mock.best||99)<=4?'near':'bad'):'bad');
1886:   const subjectState=Number(prep.subjects||0)>0?'ok':'bad';
1887:   const activityTotal=Number(prep.selected||0)+Number(prep.reports||0);
1888:   const activityState=activityTotal>=2?'ok':activityTotal===1?'near':'bad';
1889:   const reportState=Number(prep.reports||0)>=2?'ok':Number(prep.reports||0)===1?'near':'bad';
1890:   return {internal,mock:mockState,subjects:subjectState,activity:activityState,reports:reportState,internalLimit};

1939: function studentCardHeatId(student){return String(student?.id||student?.studentNo||'').trim();}
1940: function studentCardHeatPeriodDays(){try{return localStorage.getItem(STUDENT_CARD_HEAT_PERIOD_STORE)==='7'?7:30;}catch{return 30;}}

1942: function readStudentCardHeatStore(){try{const raw=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STUDENT_CARD_HEAT_STORE)||'{}');return raw&&typeof raw==='object'&&!Array.isArray(raw)?raw:{};}catch{return {};}}
1943: function writeStudentCardHeatStore(store){try{localStorage.setItem(STUDENT_CARD_HEAT_STORE,JSON.stringify(store||{}));}catch{}}
1944: function studentCardHeat(student){const id=studentCardHeatId(student);if(!id)return 0;const store=readStudentCardHeatStore(),cutoff=Date.now()-studentCardHeatPeriodDays()*86400000;const recent=(Array.isArray(store[id])?store[id]:[]).map(Number).filter(t=>Number.isFinite(t)&&t>=cutoff);return recent.length;}
1945: function touchStudentCardHeat(student){const id=studentCardHeatId(student);if(!id)return 0;const store=readStudentCardHeatStore(),history=(Array.isArray(store[id])?store[id]:[]).map(Number).filter(Number.isFinite);history.push(Date.now());store[id]=history.filter(t=>t>=Date.now()-31*86400000).slice(-80);writeStudentCardHeatStore(store);return studentCardHeat(student);}

2006: function nightStudyOperationStatus(key){
2007:   const date=new Date(`${key}T12:00:00`);
2008:   const rules=readNightStudyRules().filter(r=>r&&r.active!==false);
2009:   for(const r of rules){
2010:     if(r.type==='range'&&r.start&&r.end&&key>=r.start&&key<=r.end)return {operates:false,reason:r.name||'미운영 기간'};
2011:     if(r.type==='weekday'&&Number(r.weekday)===date.getDay())return {operates:false,reason:r.name||'요일 미운영'};
2012:   }
2013:   return {operates:true,reason:'운영일'};
2014: }

2056: function dormRuleNormalizeDateTime(value){
2057:   if(value===null||value===undefined||value==='') return '';
2058:   // Google Sheets 날짜 직렬값은 시트의 '현지 날짜/시간' 값이다.
2059:   // UTC instant로 해석한 뒤 Asia/Seoul을 다시 적용하면 +9시간이 생기므로,
2060:   // 직렬값의 날짜/시간 성분을 그대로 추출한다.
2061:   if(typeof value==='number'||/^\d+(?:\.\d+)?$/.test(String(value).trim())){
2062:     const serial=Number(value);
2063:     if(Number.isFinite(serial)&&serial>20000&&serial<100000){
2064:       const d=new Date(Date.UTC(1899,11,30)+Math.round(serial*86400000));
2065:       if(!Number.isNaN(d.getTime())){
2066:         const y=d.getUTCFullYear(),m=String(d.getUTCMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0'),day=String(d.getUTCDate()).padStart(2,'0');
2067:         const hh=String(d.getUTCHours()).padStart(2,'0'),mm=String(d.getUTCMinutes()).padStart(2,'0');
2068:         return `${y}-${m}-${day}T${hh}:${mm}`;
2069:       }
2070:     }
2071:   }
2072:   const raw=String(value).trim().replace(' ','T');
2073:   const m=raw.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{1,2})-(\d{1,2})T(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})/);
2074:   if(m) return `${m[1]}-${String(m[2]).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(m[3]).padStart(2,'0')}T${String(m[4]).padStart(2,'0')}:${m[5]}`;
2075:   return String(value).trim();
2076: }

2081: function dormRuleAppliesAt(rule,dateLike){

2085:   return Number.isFinite(stamp)&&stamp>=a&&stamp<=b;
2086: }

2276: function dormTermRoster(mode){
2277:   const term=dormTermDefinition(mode);if(!term)return [];
2278:   const all=[...(readonlyCache?.dormHistory||[]),...(readonlyCache?.pastDormStudents||[]),...(readonlyCache?.dormStudents||[])];
2279:   const seen=new Set();
2280:   return all.filter(row=>{
2281:     const year=String(row.year||'').replace(/\.0$/,'');
2282:     const sem=String(row.semester||'').replace(/[^0-9]/g,'');
2283:     const no=String(row.studentNo||'').replace(/\D/g,'');
2284:     const inferredGrade=no?Number(no[0]):Number(String(row.className||'').match(/^([123])[- ]/)?.[1]||1);
2285:     const grade=Number(row.grade||inferredGrade||1);
2286:     if(year&&term.year&&year!==term.year)return false;
2287:     if(grade!==term.grade)return false;
2288:     if(term.semester&&sem&&sem!==term.semester)return false;
2289:     if(term.semester&&!sem){
2290:       const start=String(row.startDate||'');
2291:       if(start){const month=Number(start.slice(5,7));if(term.semester==='1'&&month>=8)return false;if(term.semester==='2'&&month>0&&month<7)return false;}
2292:     }
2293:     const key=`${row.studentId||row.studentNo}|${term.label}`;if(seen.has(key))return false;seen.add(key);return true;
2294:   }).sort(dormStudentNoSort);
2295: }

2345:   return `<svg class="dorm-axis-chart" viewBox="0 0 ${w} ${h}" role="img" aria-label="성적 추세 그래프"><line x1="${left}" y1="${top}" x2="${left}" y2="${h-bottom}" class="axis"/><line x1="${left}" y1="${h-bottom}" x2="${w-right}" y2="${h-bottom}" class="axis"/>${grid}${path}${dots}</svg>`;

2402: function dormProgramTermKey(program){
2403:   const explicit=String(program.semester||program.term||'');
2404:   if(/2학년\s*1|2-1/.test(explicit))return 'g2s1';
2405:   if(/2학년\s*2|2-2/.test(explicit))return 'g2s2';
2406:   if(/3학년/.test(explicit))return 'g3';
2407:   const date=String(program.date||program.startDate||'');
2408:   const year=date.slice(0,4),month=Number(date.slice(5,7));
2409:   if(year==='2026')return month&&month<=7?'g1s1':'g1s2';
2410:   if(year==='2027')return month&&month<=7?'g2s1':'g2s2';
2411:   if(year==='2028')return 'g3';
2412:   return '';
2413: }

2451: function dormInseoulGap(student){
2452:   const row=admissionManagementDataset('inseoul').find(x=>String(x.student?.id||'')===String(student.id||''));
2453:   const standard=row?.standard||{internal:uepManagementRule('inseoul').internal,mockText:uepManagementRule('inseoul').mockText};
2454:   const actual=row?.base?.actual9;
2455:   const internalGap=actual==null?null:Math.max(0,(actual-Number(standard.internal))/Number(standard.internal)*100);
2456:   const levels=(row?.mock?.mainLevels||[]).filter(Number.isFinite);
2457:   const within3=levels.filter(v=>v<=3).length,within2=levels.filter(v=>v<=2).length;
2458:   const mockScore=levels.length?Math.min(100,((Math.min(within3,3)+Math.min(within2,2))/5)*100):null;
2459:   const mockGap=mockScore==null?null:100-mockScore;
2460:   const overall=[internalGap,mockGap].filter(v=>v!=null).length?Math.max(...[internalGap,mockGap].filter(v=>v!=null)):null;
2461:   const gaps=[];
2462:   if(actual==null)gaps.push('내신 9등급 환산자료 확인 필요');
2463:   else if(actual>standard.internal)gaps.push(`내신 ${actual.toFixed(2)} → 핵심기준 ${Number(standard.internal).toFixed(2)} 이내 보완`);
2464:   else gaps.push(`내신 핵심기준 충족 (${actual.toFixed(2)})`);
2465:   if(levels.length<3)gaps.push('국·수·영 모의고사 자료 보완');
2466:   else{
2467:     levels.forEach((v,i)=>{if(v>3)gaps.push(`${['국어','수학','영어'][i]||'주요영역'} ${v}등급 → 3등급 이내`);});
2468:     if(within2<2)gaps.push(`국·수·영 2등급 이내 ${within2}개 → 2개 필요`);
2469:     if(within3===3&&within2>=2)gaps.push('모의고사 인서울 핵심기준 충족');
2470:   }
2471:   return {row,standard,actual,internalGap,mockGap,overall,gaps};
2472: }

2739: function programParticipationFor(student, day, slot) {
2740:   const id = String(student?.id || student?.studentId || "");
2741:   const number = String(student?.studentNo || "");
2742:   const connected = (readonlyCache?.programs || []).filter(program=>program?.kind!=="after");

2746:     const key = `${program.id || ""}|${program.date || ""}|${program.title || ""}|${program.time || ""}`;
2747:     if (seen.has(key)) return false; seen.add(key); return true;
2748:   });
2749:   for (const program of programs) {
2750:     if(isWholeSchoolCommonActivity(program))continue;
2751:     if (program.date !== day || !programOverlapsSlot(program, slot)) continue;
2752:     const target = (program.students || []).find(item => String(item.studentId || "") === id || (number && String(item.studentNo || item.number || "") === number));
2753:     if (!target) continue;

2756:     // 13_출석부의 활성 수강명단은 출석상태가 '등록'이어도 해당 실제 차시에는 프로그램 참여자로 본다.
2757:     // 실제 수업일·야자영향타임은 program.date/program.time 단계에서 이미 검증되므로 명단 등록만으로 다른 날짜에 표시되지 않는다.
2758:     const confirmed = !inactive && ((typeof nightRecordIsAttendance === "function" && nightRecordIsAttendance(target)) || /출석|정상|참여|입실|명단QR|학사|등록|신청/.test(participationText));
2759:     return {program, target, confirmed, pending: !confirmed && !inactive};
2760:   }
2761:   return null;

2895: function uepComparableDate(value,basis=attendanceViewDate||dateKey(today)){
2896:   if(value==null||value==='')return '';
2897:   if(typeof value==='object')value=value.formattedValue||value.value||value.date||value.serial||'';
2898:   const text=String(value).trim();
2899:   // __UEP_08160_ISO_CALENDAR_DATE__
2900:   if(/^20\d{2}-\d{2}-\d{2}T.*(?:Z|[+-]\d{2}:?\d{2})$/i.test(text)){
2901:     const instant=new Date(text);
2902:     if(!Number.isNaN(instant.getTime())){
2903:       const parts=new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA',{timeZone:'Asia/Seoul',year:'numeric',month:'2-digit',day:'2-digit'}).formatToParts(instant);
2904:       const p=Object.fromEntries(parts.map(part=>[part.type,part.value]));
2905:       if(p.year&&p.month&&p.day)return p.year+'-'+p.month+'-'+p.day;
2906:     }
2907:   }
2908:   if(/^\d{5}(?:\.\d+)?$/.test(text)){
2909:     const serial=Number(text),utc=new Date(Math.round((serial-25569)*86400000));
2910:     if(!Number.isNaN(utc.getTime()))return `${utc.getUTCFullYear()}-${String(utc.getUTCMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(utc.getUTCDate()).padStart(2,'0')}`;
2911:   }
2912:   const full=text.match(/(20\d{2})[^0-9]+(\d{1,2})[^0-9]+(\d{1,2})/);
2913:   if(full)return `${full[1]}-${full[2].padStart(2,'0')}-${full[3].padStart(2,'0')}`;
2914:   const compact=text.replace(/\D/g,'');
2915:   if(/^20\d{6}$/.test(compact))return compact.slice(0,4)+'-'+compact.slice(4,6)+'-'+compact.slice(6,8);
2916:   const monthDay=text.match(/(?:^|\D)(\d{1,2})\s*(?:월|[.\-/])\s*(\d{1,2})(?:\s*일)?(?:\D|$)/);
2917:   if(monthDay){const year=String(basis||dateKey(today)).slice(0,4)||'2026';return year+'-'+monthDay[1].padStart(2,'0')+'-'+monthDay[2].padStart(2,'0');}
2918:   const parsed=new Date(text);
2919:   if(!Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime()))return `${parsed.getFullYear()}-${String(parsed.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(parsed.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')}`;

3420: async function inputCenterRunAutoOCR(drafts){

3425:   for(const d of drafts){const pages=Array.isArray(d.pages)&&d.pages.length?d.pages:[{filePath:d.filePath}];const texts=[],engines=new Set(),errors=[];pages.forEach((p,i)=>{const r=byKey.get(`${d.draftId}::${i}`);if(!r)return;if(r.ok&&r.text)texts.push(`[${i+1}페이지]\n${r.text}`);if(r.engine)engines.add(r.engine);if(!r.ok)errors.push(`${i+1}p ${r.reason||r.status||'OCR 실패'}`);});d.text=texts.join('\n\n').trim();d.rawText=d.text;d.ocrEngine=[...engines].join(' + ');d.ocrError=errors.join(' / ');d.ocrStatus=errors.length?(d.text?'OCR확인필요':'OCR오류'):(d.text?'OCR완료':'OCR확인필요');inputCenterApplyOcrMatch(d);}

3464: function inputCenterHumanReportText(value=''){
3465:   const source=String(value||'').trim();if(!source)return '';
3466:   try{
3467:     const meta=JSON.parse(source);
3468:     const fields=Array.isArray(meta?.fields)?meta.fields:Array.isArray(meta)?meta:[];
3469:     const skip=/^(연락처|전화번호|휴대폰|서명|이메일|학번|성명|이름|학년|반|수정시간|제출시간|제출일시)$/;
3470:     const pairs=fields.map((f,i)=>({label:String(f?.label||`문항 ${i+1}`).trim(),value:String(f?.value||'').trim()})).filter(x=>x.value&&!skip.test(x.label));
3471:     if(pairs.length)return pairs.map(x=>`[${x.label||'문항'}]\n${x.value}`).join('\n\n');
3472:   }catch{}
3473:   return source;
3474: }

3562: function submissionDateText(value){
3563:   const raw=String(value??"").trim();
3564:   if(!raw)return "-";
3565:   const serial=Number(raw);
3566:   let date=null;
3567:   if(Number.isFinite(serial)&&serial>20000&&serial<100000)date=new Date(Date.UTC(1899,11,30)+serial*86400000);
3568:   else{
3569:     const parsed=Date.parse(raw.replace(/오전/g,"AM").replace(/오후/g,"PM"));
3570:     if(Number.isFinite(parsed))date=new Date(parsed);
3571:   }
3572:   if(!date||Number.isNaN(date.getTime()))return raw;
3573:   return `${date.getFullYear()}.${String(date.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,"0")}.${String(date.getDate()).padStart(2,"0")}`;
3574: }

3848: function printScorePackage(student,mode){
3849:   if(!student)return;
3850:   const all=(readonlyCache?.scoreRecords||[]).filter(r=>r.studentId===student.id);
3851:   const internal=all.filter(r=>r.scoreType==="내신");
3852:   const mock=all.filter(r=>r.scoreType==="모의고사");
3853:   const gradeRows=internal.filter(r=>Number.isFinite(Number(r.level)));
3854:   const printWeightedAverage=uepCommonWeightedAverage(gradeRows,r=>Number(r.level));
3855:   const avg=Number.isFinite(printWeightedAverage)?printWeightedAverage.toFixed(2):"-";
3856:   const mockExams=[...new Set(mock.map(r=>r.exam).filter(Boolean))].sort((a,b)=>scoreExamOrder(a)-scoreExamOrder(b));
3857:   const latestMock=mockExams.at(-1)||"-";
3858:   const subjects=[...new Set(mock.map(r=>r.subject).filter(Boolean))];
3859:   const summary=`<div class="score-print-summary"><div><small>최근 내신 평균</small><b>${avg}</b><span>등급 평균</span></div><div><small>내신 자료</small><b>${internal.length}</b><span>과목·시험 기록</span></div><div><small>최근 모의고사</small><b>${escapeHtml(latestMock)}</b><span>${mock.length}개 성적</span></div><div><small>조회범위</small><b>${mode==="combined"?"종합":mode==="mock"?"모의":"내신"}</b><span>개인별 누적</span></div></div>`;
3860:   const internalExams=[...new Set(internal.map(r=>r.exam).filter(Boolean))].sort((a,b)=>scoreExamOrder(a)-scoreExamOrder(b));
3861:   const internalSubjects=[...new Set(internal.map(r=>r.subject).filter(Boolean))];
3862:   const internalTable=`<section class="print-section"><h2>내신 누적 성적</h2><table class="score-wide"><thead><tr><th>과목</th>${internalExams.map(e=>`<th>${escapeHtml(e)}<small>등급 / 원점수</small></th>`).join("")}</tr></thead><tbody>${internalSubjects.map(subject=>`<tr><td>${escapeHtml(subject)}</td>${internalExams.map(exam=>{const r=internal.find(x=>x.subject===subject&&x.exam===exam);return `<td>${r?`<b>${escapeHtml(scoreDisplay(r.level))}등급</b><small>${escapeHtml(scoreDisplay(r.rawScore))}점 · ${escapeHtml(r.achievement||"")}</small>`:"-"}</td>`}).join("")}</tr>`).join("")}</tbody></table></section>`;
3863:   const mockTable=`<section class="print-section"><h2>모의고사 비교</h2><table class="score-wide mock"><thead><tr><th>영역</th>${mockExams.map(e=>`<th>${escapeHtml(e)}<small>등급 / 원점수 / 표준</small></th>`).join("")}</tr></thead><tbody>${subjects.map(subject=>`<tr><td>${escapeHtml(subject)}</td>${mockExams.map(exam=>{const r=mock.find(x=>x.subject===subject&&x.exam===exam);return `<td>${r?`<b>${escapeHtml(scoreDisplay(r.level))}등급</b><small>${escapeHtml(scoreDisplay(r.rawScore))}점 · 표준 ${escapeHtml(scoreDisplay(r.standardScore))}${r.percentile!==""?` · 백분위 ${escapeHtml(scoreDisplay(r.percentile))}`:""}</small>`:"-"}</td>`}).join("")}</tr>`).join("")}</tbody></table></section>`;
3864:   const body=`<header class="print-head score-title"><small>UNHO EDUCATION PLATFORM · 학생상담 성적 종합</small><h1>${escapeHtml(student.studentNo)} ${escapeHtml(student.name)}</h1><p>진로희망: ${escapeHtml(student.career||"-")} · 전체 누적 성적</p>${studentPrintBadgesMarkup(student)}</header>${summary}${mode!=="mock"?internalTable:""}${mode!=="internal"?mockTable:""}`;
3865:   openPrintDocument(`${student.studentNo}_${student.name}_성적상담자료`,body,"portrait");

4746: function scorePeriodKey(row) {
4747:   const year = String(row?.schoolYear || today.getFullYear()).replace(/[^0-9]/g, "") || String(today.getFullYear());
4748:   let semester = String(row?.semester || "").match(/[12]/)?.[0] || "";
4749:   if (!semester && row?.scoreType === "모의고사") {
4750:     const month = Number(String(row.exam || "").match(/(\d{1,2})\s*월/)?.[1] || 0);
4751:     semester = month && month >= 8 ? "2" : "1";
4752:   }
4753:   return `${year}-${semester || "1"}`;
4754: }
4755: function scorePeriodLabel(key) {
4756:   if (!key || key === "all") return "전체 누적";
4757:   const [year, semester] = String(key).split("-");
4758:   return `${year}학년도 ${semester || "1"}학기`;
4759: }
4760: function availableScorePeriods(mode = scoreMode) {
4761:   const rows = (readonlyCache?.scoreRecords || []).filter(row => mode === "combined" || row.scoreType === (mode === "mock" ? "모의고사" : "내신"));
4762:   return [...new Set(rows.map(scorePeriodKey).filter(Boolean))].sort((a,b)=>a.localeCompare(b));
4763: }
4764: function scoreExamOrder(exam) {
4765:   const order = ["1차고사","2차고사","학기말고사","3월모의고사","6월모의고사","9월모의고사","10월모의고사","11월모의고사","수능"];
4766:   const index = order.indexOf(exam);
4767:   return index < 0 ? 999 : index;
4768: }
4769: function scoreTrend(row, allRows) {
4770:   const orders = row.scoreType === "모의고사" ? ["3월모의고사","6월모의고사","9월모의고사","10월모의고사","11월모의고사"] : ["1차고사","2차고사","학기말고사"];
4771:   const index = orders.indexOf(row.exam);
4772:   if (index <= 0 || row.level === "" || row.level == null) return { text:"-", cls:"" };
4773:   const period = scorePeriodKey(row);
4774:   const previous = allRows.find(x => x.studentId === row.studentId && x.scoreType === row.scoreType && x.subject === row.subject && x.exam === orders[index - 1] && scorePeriodKey(x) === period);
4775:   if (!previous || previous.level === "" || previous.level == null) return { text:"-", cls:"" };
4776:   const diff = Number(previous.level) - Number(row.level);
4777:   if (!Number.isFinite(diff) || diff === 0) return { text:"유지", cls:"" };
4778:   return diff > 0 ? { text:`▲ ${Math.abs(diff)}등급`, cls:"good" } : { text:`▼ ${Math.abs(diff)}등급`, cls:"bad" };
4779: }
4780: function gradeToneClass(value) {
4781:   const grade = Number(value);
4782:   return Number.isFinite(grade) && grade >= 1 && grade <= 9 ? `grade-${grade}` : "grade-na";
4783: }
4784: function gradeBadgeMarkup(value, suffix = "등급") {

4786:   const number = Number(value);
4787:   if (!Number.isFinite(number)) return `<span class="grade-badge grade-na">${escapeHtml(String(value))}</span>`;
4788:   return `<span class="grade-badge ${gradeToneClass(number)}"><b>${scoreDisplay(number,2)}</b><small>${suffix}</small></span>`;

4944: function uepCommonCourseKey(value){
4945:   return String(value||'').replace(/\s+/g,'').replace(/[ⅠⅡⅢ]/g,ch=>({'Ⅰ':'I','Ⅱ':'II','Ⅲ':'III'}[ch]||ch)).replace(/[*＊]/g,'');

4947: function uepCommonCreditOf(row){
4948:   const key=uepCommonCourseKey(row?.subject||row?.course||row?.courseName||row?.['과목명']);
4949:   const curriculumRows=Array.isArray(readonlyCache?.curriculumDb)?readonlyCache.curriculumDb:[];
4950:   const credits=[...new Set(curriculumRows.filter(c=>uepCommonCourseKey(c?.['과목명'])===key).map(c=>Number(c?.['이수단위'])).filter(n=>Number.isFinite(n)&&n>0))];
4951:   if(credits.length===1)return credits[0];
4952:   const direct=[row?.credit,row?.credits,row?.courseCredit,row?.unitCredit,row?.['이수학점'],row?.['이수단위'],row?.['학점']].map(Number).find(n=>Number.isFinite(n)&&n>0);
4953:   if(direct)return direct;
4954:   console.warn('[UEP common weighted grade] credit unresolved',{subject:row?.subject||row?.['과목명'],row});
4955:   return null;
4956: }
4957: function uepCommonWeightedAverage(items,valueFn,rowFn=(x=>x)){
4958:   const weighted=(items||[]).map(item=>{const value=Number(valueFn(item));const row=rowFn(item);const credit=uepCommonCreditOf(row);return {value,credit};}).filter(x=>Number.isFinite(x.value)&&Number.isFinite(x.credit)&&x.credit>0);
4959:   const credits=weighted.reduce((sum,x)=>sum+x.credit,0);
4960:   return credits?weighted.reduce((sum,x)=>sum+x.value*x.credit,0)/credits:null;
4961: }

5168: function fiveGradeBoundaryData(enrollment) {
5169:   const total = Math.max(1, Math.round(Number(enrollment) || 1));
5170:   const cumulativeRates = [0.10, 0.34, 0.66, 0.90, 1];
5171:   const cumulative = cumulativeRates.map(rate => Math.round(total * rate));
5172:   cumulative[cumulative.length - 1] = total;
5173:   const counts = cumulative.map((value, index) => value - (index ? cumulative[index - 1] : 0));
5174:   return { total, cumulative, counts };
5175: }

5198: function actualNineGrade(row) {
5199:   let rank = Number(String(row?.rank ?? "").replace(/[^0-9.]/g,""));
5200:   let enrollment = Number(String(row?.enrollment ?? "").replace(/[^0-9.]/g,""));
5201:   let derived=false;
5202:   if((!Number.isFinite(rank)||rank<=0)&&Number.isFinite(scoreNumeric(row?.rawScore))){
5203:     const raw=scoreNumeric(row.rawScore);
5204:     const peers=(readonlyCache?.scoreRecords||[]).filter(peer=>
5205:       peer?.scoreType==="내신"&&String(peer.exam||"")===String(row?.exam||"")&&String(peer.subject||"")===String(row?.subject||"")&&
5206:       String(peer.year||"")===String(row?.year||"")&&String(peer.semester||"")===String(row?.semester||"")&&Number.isFinite(scoreNumeric(peer.rawScore))
5207:     );
5208:     if(peers.length){
5209:       rank=peers.filter(peer=>scoreNumeric(peer.rawScore)>raw).length+1;
5210:       if(!Number.isFinite(enrollment)||enrollment<=0)enrollment=peers.length;
5211:       derived=true;
5212:     }
5213:   }
5214:   if (!Number.isFinite(rank) || !Number.isFinite(enrollment) || rank <= 0 || enrollment <= 0) return null;
5215:   const percentile = rank / enrollment * 100;
5216:   const grade = percentile <= 4 ? 1 : percentile <= 11 ? 2 : percentile <= 23 ? 3 : percentile <= 40 ? 4 : percentile <= 60 ? 5 : percentile <= 77 ? 6 : percentile <= 89 ? 7 : percentile <= 96 ? 8 : 9;
5217:   return { grade, percentile, rank, enrollment, derived, detail:`${rank}/${enrollment}명 = 상위 ${percentile.toFixed(1)}%${derived?' · 원점수 기준 추정석차':''}` };
5218: }
5219: function actualNineAverage(rows) {
5220:   const details = rows.map(row=>({row,result:actualNineGrade(row)})).filter(item=>item.result);
5221:   const average = details.length ? details.reduce((sum,item)=>sum+item.result.grade,0)/details.length : null;
5222:   return { average, details };
5223: }

5735: function recordAreaKey(value){
5736:   const text=String(value||"").replace(/\s/g,"");
5737:   // 공통활동마스터의 교육과정 내 봉사는 진로 이수시간에 포함하지 않습니다.
5738:   // 활동영역 문자열에 진로가 함께 들어 있어도 봉사활동을 우선 분리합니다.
5739:   if(/봉사/.test(text))return "autonomy";
5740:   if(/진로/.test(text))return "career";
5741:   if(/자율|공통|선택/.test(text))return "autonomy";
5742:   return "other";
5743: }
5744: function recordProgramMatchName(value){
5745:   return String(value||"").normalize("NFKC")
5746:     .replace(/\s*[（(\[]\s*(?:20\d{2}[.\-/년]\s*)?\d{1,2}[.\-/월]\s*\d{1,2}(?:[.\-/일]\s*)?(?:[~～\-–—]\s*(?:20\d{2}[.\-/년]\s*)?\d{1,2}[.\-/월]\s*\d{1,2}(?:[.\-/일]\s*)?)?\s*[）)\]]\s*$/u, "")
5747:     .replace(/\s*[·|]\s*(?:20\d{2})?[.\-/년\s]*\d{1,2}[.\-/월\s]+\d{1,2}(?:\s*일)?\s*$/u, "")
5748:     .replace(/[\s·ㆍ.,:;()\[\]{}'"`~!@#$%^&*+=_|\\/<>?–—-]+/g, "")
5749:     .toLowerCase();
5750: }
5751: function unifiedProgramId(value){
5752:   return String(value||"").trim().replace(/^(?:common-|selected-|after-(?:session|master|course)-)+/,"");
5753: }
5754: function unifiedProgramSemester(program){
5755:   const explicit=String(program?.semester||program?.term||"").trim();
5756:   if(/1/.test(explicit))return "1학기";
5757:   if(/2/.test(explicit))return "2학기";
5758:   const month=Number(String(program?.date||program?.startDate||"").slice(5,7));
5759:   return month&&month<=7?"1학기":month?"2학기":"";

5761: function resolveStudentProgramReport(program,student,reports){
5762:   const pool=(reports||readonlyCache?.programReports||readonlyCache?.reports||[]).filter(r=>r&&r.submitted!==false);
5763:   const sid=String(student?.studentId||student?.id||"").trim();
5764:   const sno=String(student?.studentNo||student?.number||"").replace(/\D/g,"").slice(-4);
5765:   const studentPool=pool.filter(report=>{
5766:     const rsid=String(report.studentId||"").trim();
5767:     const rsno=String(report.studentNo||report.number||"").replace(/\D/g,"").slice(-4);
5768:     return (sid&&rsid===sid)||(sno&&rsno===sno);
5769:   });
5770:   if(!studentPool.length)return null;
5771: 
5772:   // 공통활동은 마스터에서 보고서사용=Y인 활동만 보고서 연결 대상입니다.
5773:   // 같은 이름의 후속 학기 활동에 이전 학기 보고서가 붙는 것을 원천 차단합니다.
5774:   const kind=String(program?.kind||program?.programType||program?.activityType||"").toLowerCase();
5775:   const isCommon=kind==="common"||String(program?.id||"").startsWith("common-");
5776:   if(isCommon && program?.reportRequired===false)return null;
5777: 
5778:   const semester=unifiedProgramSemester(program);
5779:   const semesterPool=studentPool.filter(report=>{
5780:     const rSemester=String(report.semester||"").trim();
5781:     return !(semester&&rSemester&&semester!==rSemester);
5782:   });
5783:   const preferredPool=semesterPool.length?semesterPool:studentPool;
5784:   const newest=items=>items.slice().sort((a,b)=>String(b.finalSubmittedAt||b.submittedAt||b.date||'').localeCompare(String(a.finalSubmittedAt||a.submittedAt||a.date||'')))[0]||null;
5785: 
5786:   const pid=unifiedProgramId(program?.programId||program?.activityId||program?.id||"");
5787:   if(pid){
5788:     const exact=studentPool.filter(report=>unifiedProgramId(report.programId||report.activityId||report.sourceProgramId||report.linkedProgramId||"")===pid);
5789:     if(exact.length)return newest(exact);
5790:   }
5791: 
5792:   const pnames=[program?.recordTitle,program?.actualTitle,program?.title,program?.programName].map(recordProgramMatchName).filter(Boolean);
5793:   const nameMatches=pool=>pool.filter(report=>{
5794:     const rnames=[report.reportGroup,report.programName,report.programTitle,report.activityTitle,report.title].map(recordProgramMatchName).filter(Boolean);
5795:     return pnames.some(name=>rnames.includes(name));
5796:   });
5797:   const preferredNames=nameMatches(preferredPool);
5798:   if(preferredNames.length)return newest(preferredNames);
5799:   const fallbackNames=nameMatches(studentPool);
5800:   if(fallbackNames.length)return newest(fallbackNames);
5801: 
5802:   return semesterPool.find(report=>{
5803:     const rnames=[report.reportGroup,report.programName,report.programTitle,report.activityTitle,report.title].map(recordProgramMatchName).filter(Boolean);
5804:     return pnames.some(name=>rnames.some(rname=>name&&rname&&(name.includes(rname)||rname.includes(name))));
5805:   })||null;
5806: }

5859: function recordAreaLabel(area){return area==="autonomy"?"자율활동 특기사항":area==="career"?"진로활동 특기사항":"종합의견(행동발달 특기사항)";}
5860: function recordAreaLimit(area){
5861:   const rules=readonlyCache?.recordRuleRows||[];
5862:   for(const row of rules){
5863:     const text=Object.values(row).join(" ");
5864:     if((area==="autonomy"&&/자율/.test(text))||(area==="career"&&/진로/.test(text))||(area==="behavior"&&/행동|종합의견/.test(text))){
5865:       const numbers=[...text.matchAll(/(\d{3,4})\s*(?:자|글자|byte|바이트)/gi)].map(m=>Number(m[1]));

5950: function weekdaysBetween(start,end){
5951:   let a=new Date(`${start}T12:00:00`),b=new Date(`${end||start}T12:00:00`),out=[];
5952:   if(Number.isNaN(a.getTime())||Number.isNaN(b.getTime()))return out;
5953:   // 공통 진로활동의 종료일이 없더라도 해당 날짜가 속한 월~금 전체를 조회합니다.
5954:   if(!end||start===end){
5955:     const day=a.getDay();
5956:     const offset=day===0?-6:1-day;
5957:     a=new Date(a);a.setDate(a.getDate()+offset);
5958:     b=new Date(a);b.setDate(b.getDate()+4);
5959:   }
5960:   for(const d=new Date(a);d<=b;d.setDate(d.getDate()+1)){if(d.getDay()>=1&&d.getDay()<=5)out.push(dateKeyLocal(d));}
5961:   return out;
5962: }

6157: function enforceTeacherEnding(text){
6158:   const teacherEnding=/함\.?$|됨\.?$|임\.?$|보임\.?$|돋보임\.?$|기여함\.?$|발휘함\.?$|확장함\.?$|심화함\.?$|이해함\.?$|수행함\.?$|참여함\.?$/;

6166:     ];
6167:     for(const [rx,repl] of replacements){if(rx.test(s)){s=s.replace(rx,repl);break;}}

6175:   };
6176:   return String(text||"").split(/(?<=[.!?])\s+|(?<=…)\s+/).map(convertSentence).filter(Boolean).join(" ");

6178: function normalizedSentenceTokens(text){
6179:   return new Set(String(text||"").replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}\s]/gu," ").split(/\s+/).filter(x=>x.length>=2));

6181: function jaccardSimilarity(a,b){
6182:   const A=normalizedSentenceTokens(a),B=normalizedSentenceTokens(b);
6183:   if(!A.size||!B.size)return 0;
6184:   let both=0;A.forEach(x=>{if(B.has(x))both++;});
6185:   return both/(A.size+B.size-both);
6186: }

6488: function recordRuleField(row,names){
6489:   for(const name of names){
6490:     const key=Object.keys(row||{}).find(k=>String(k).replace(/\s/g,"").includes(name));
6491:     const value=key?String(row[key]??"").trim():"";
6492:     if(value)return value;
6493:   }
6494:   return "";
6495: }
6496: function applySchoolRecordGuardrails(text){
6497:   let out=String(text||"").replace(/\s+/g," ").trim();
6498:   // 33_생기부작성절대규칙과 35_금지표현DB는 학교 검증 규칙이므로 완화하지 않고 최종 강제 적용한다.
6499:   recordRuleRowsBySource("35_금지표현DB").forEach(row=>{
6500:     const forbidden=recordRuleField(row,["금지표현","금지어"]);
6501:     if(!forbidden||forbidden.length>60)return;
6502:     const enabled=recordRuleField(row,["사용여부","활성화여부"]);
6503:     if(enabled&&/^N$/i.test(enabled))return;
6504:     if(!out.includes(forbidden))return;
6505:     const replacement=recordRuleField(row,["수정추천표현","추천표현","대체표현"]);
6506:     const auto=recordRuleField(row,["자동치환여부","자동치환"]);
6507:     if(replacement&&(!auto||/^Y$/i.test(auto)))out=out.split(forbidden).join(replacement);
6508:   });
6509:   return enforceTeacherEnding(out);
6510: }

6562: function buildIntegratedRecordDraft(student,bundle,rows,area,limit){
6563:   let result=buildMultiRecordDraft(rows,area,limit);
6564:   const interp=recordStudentInterpretation(student,bundle);
6565:   const selectedReports=rows.filter(row=>row.report);
6566:   if(selectedReports.length>=2){
6567:     const focus=interp.majors?.[0]?.label||interp.careers?.[0]?.label||interp.sdgs?.[0]?.name||"관련 주제";
6568:     const continuity=`여러 활동에서 ${focus}에 대한 관심을 이어가며 탐구와 성찰의 내용을 연결하는 모습을 보임.`;
6569:     if(!result.includes(continuity)&&result.length+continuity.length+1<=limit)result=`${result} ${continuity}`.trim();
6570:   }
6571:   if(area==="behavior"&&rows.length===0){
6572:     const facts=[];
6573:     if(interp.insideService.length)facts.push("교육과정 내 봉사활동에 참여하며 공동체의 일원으로 주어진 활동을 수행함.");
6574:     if(interp.leadership.length)facts.push("학급 및 학교 공동체에서 맡은 역할을 수행하며 구성원과 함께 활동함.");
6575:     result=facts.join(" ");
6576:   }
6577:   const obs=observationText(student,area);if(obs)result=`${result} ${obs}`.trim();
6578:   result=applySchoolRecordGuardrails(result);
6579:   if(result.length>limit)result=applySchoolRecordGuardrails(result.slice(0,Math.max(20,limit-12)).replace(/\s+\S*$/,""));
6580:   return result.slice(0,limit);
6581: }

6622: function runRecordRuleCheck(text,area){

7723: function normalizeTeacherTimetableCell(cell){

7730:   }

7732:   const room=String(cell.location||cell.room||cell.classroom||cell.gradeClass||cell.classNo||"").trim();
7733:   return subject?{subject,room,changed:Boolean(cell.isChanged||cell.changed||cell.changeInfo),changeInfo:cell.changeInfo||""}:null;
7734: }

7895: function schoolPeriodStatus(now) {
7896:   const minute = now.getHours() * 60 + now.getMinutes();
7897:   const periods = [[520,570],[580,630],[640,690],[700,750],[820,870],[880,930],[940,990]];
7898:   const index = periods.findIndex(([start, end]) => minute >= start && minute <= end);
7899:   if (index >= 0) return { index, label: `현재 ${index + 1}교시` };
7900:   if (minute < periods[0][0]) return { index: -1, label: "일과 시작 전" };
7901:   if (minute > periods[6][1]) return { index: -1, label: "정규수업 종료" };
7902:   if (minute >= 750 && minute < 820) return { index: -1, label: "점심시간" };
7903:   return { index: -1, label: "쉬는 시간" };
7904: }

8282: function dashboardAfterProgramsForDay(dayKey){
8283:   // 일정 표시는 강좌 마스터가 아니라 실제 차시만 사용한다.
8284:   // afterSchoolProgramGroups()가 12_차시일정/실제 일정과 과거 출결 fallback을 단일화한다.
8285:   const canonical=typeof afterSchoolProgramGroups==="function"?afterSchoolProgramGroups():[];
8286:   const seen=new Set();
8287:   return canonical.filter(program=>{
8288:     if(!program||program.kind!=="after"||program.isCourseMaster) return false;
8289:     const pday=String(program.date||program.sessionDate||program.operationDate||"").slice(0,10);
8290:     if(pday!==dayKey||!programHasNightStudyImpact(program)||/취소|휴강|결강|폐강|미운영/.test(String(program.status||program.operationState||program.sessionStatus||""))) return false;
8291:     const session=String(program.sessionId||"").trim();
8292:     const course=String(program.courseId||program.programId||program.id||"").replace(/^after-(?:course|master|session)-/,"").trim();
8293:     const slot=typeof dashboardProgramNightSlot==="function"?dashboardProgramNightSlot(program):String(program.time||"");
8294:     const title=String(program.actualTitle||program.title||program.type||"").replace(/\s/g,"").trim();
8295:     const key=session?`session|${session}`:[course,pday,slot,title].join("|");
8296:     if(seen.has(key)) return false;
8297:     seen.add(key);
8298:     return true;
8299:   });
8300: }

9422: function dashboardTodayProgramVisible(program){

9487: function normalizeTimetableGradeClass(row){
9488:   const directGrade=Number(row?.grade??row?.학년??0);
9489:   const directClass=Number(row?.classNo??row?.class??row?.반??0);
9490:   if(directGrade>=1&&directGrade<=3&&directClass>=1&&directClass<=20)return {grade:directGrade,classNo:directClass};
9491:   const raw=String(row?.classCode??row?.classroom??row?.학급??row?.반코드??row?.['학년반']??'').trim();
9492:   const digits=raw.replace(/\D/g,'');
9493:   if(digits.length===3){
9494:     const grade=Number(digits[0]),classNo=Number(digits.slice(1));
9495:     if(grade>=1&&grade<=3&&classNo>=1&&classNo<=20)return {grade,classNo};
9496:   }
9497:   if(digits.length===4){
9498:     const grade=Number(digits[0]),classNo=Number(digits.slice(1,3));
9499:     if(grade>=1&&grade<=3&&classNo>=1&&classNo<=20)return {grade,classNo};
9500:   }
9501:   return {grade:directGrade||1,classNo:directClass||Number(digits)||0};
9502: }

10230: function shiftTimetableDate(value, amountDays) {

10232:   if (Number.isNaN(base.getTime())) return dateKey(new Date());

10234:   return dateKey(base);

10236: function timetableWeekLabel(value) {
10237:   const base = new Date(`${String(value || dateKey(new Date()))}T12:00:00`);
10238:   if (Number.isNaN(base.getTime())) return "주간 선택";
10239:   const day = base.getDay();
10240:   base.setDate(base.getDate() + (day === 0 ? -6 : 1 - day));
10241:   const end = new Date(base); end.setDate(end.getDate() + 4);
10242:   const md = d => `${d.getMonth()+1}/${d.getDate()}`;
10243:   return `${md(base)} ~ ${md(end)}`;
10244: }

10333: function studentAccessContext(student){

10336:   const ownClass=String(scope.classNo||"").replace(/[^0-9]/g,"");

10341:   const isReadOnlyLeadership=role==="vice_principal"||role==="principal";
10342:   const canEditContact=!isReadOnlyLeadership&&(isAdmin||role==="grade_head"||isOwnHomeroom); /* UEP_08282_CONTACT_WRITE_SCOPE */
10343:   return {role,isAdmin,isOwnHomeroom,isOtherHomeroom,isReadOnlyLeadership,canEditContact};

10501: function strictAdmissionCutLimit(value){
10502:   if(value===null||value===undefined||value==='')return null;
10503:   const direct=Number(value);if(Number.isFinite(direct)&&direct>=1&&direct<=9)return direct;
10504:   const values=(String(value).replace(/,/g,'').match(/\d+(?:\.\d+)?/g)||[]).map(Number).filter(v=>Number.isFinite(v)&&v>=1&&v<=9);
10505:   if(!values.length)return null;
10506:   // 복수 숫자가 들어간 문자열은 더 엄격한 값(작은 등급)으로 판정하여 오탐을 막습니다.
10507:   return Math.min(...values);
10508: }
10509: function studentUniversityBadgeEvidence(student){
10510:   const cacheKey=`${readonlyCache?.syncedAt||''}|${student.id||student.studentNo||''}|badge-evidence-v6-discovery`;
10511:   if(studentBadgeCache.has(cacheKey))return studentBadgeCache.get(cacheKey);
10512:   const base=admissionBase(student.id);
10513:   const snapshot=latestMockSnapshot(student.id);
10514:   const mockRows=snapshot.rows||[];
10515:   if(base.actual9==null){studentBadgeCache.set(cacheKey,[]);return [];}
10516:   const cuts=(readonlyCache?.admissionCuts||[]).filter(cut=>String(cut.discoveryUse||'Y').toUpperCase()!=='N');
10517:   const rules=(readonlyCache?.admissionMinimums||[]).filter(rule=>String(rule.discoveryStatus||'').trim()!=='사용보류');
10518:   const ruleMap=new Map();
10519:   rules.forEach(rule=>{const key=universityNameKey(rule.university);if(!key)return;if(!ruleMap.has(key))ruleMap.set(key,[]);ruleMap.get(key).push(rule);});
10520:   const evidence=[];
10521:   for(const cut of cuts){
10522:     const key=universityNameKey(cut.university);if(!key)continue;
10523:     const limit=strictAdmissionCutLimit(cut.cut);if(limit==null||base.actual9>limit)continue;
10524:     const universityRules=ruleMap.get(key)||[];
10525:     const compatible=universityRules.map(rule=>({rule,match:admissionPairCompatibility(cut,rule)})).filter(x=>x.match.ok).sort((a,b)=>(b.match.level||0)-(a.match.level||0));
10526:     let accepted=null;
10527:     for(const {rule,match} of compatible){
10528:       const check=minimumCheck(rule,mockRows);
10529:       if(check.result==='충족'||check.result==='미적용'){
10530:         accepted={rule,match,check};break;
10531:       }
10532:     }
10533:     if(accepted){
10534:       const {rule,match,check}=accepted;
10535:       evidence.push({university:String(cut.university||rule.university||''),cut,rule,limit,actual9:base.actual9,minimumResult:check.result,minimumDetail:check.detail||'',mockExam:snapshot.exam||'',mockDetail:snapshot.detail||'',pairReason:match.reason,pairLevel:match.level||0,discoveryReason:cut.discoveryReason||'',recheck:cut.recheck||'',discoveryMode:'입결+수능최저'});
10536:       continue;
10537:     }
10538:     // 1학년 학생 발굴은 운호고 실제 합격 입결을 중심축으로 사용합니다.
10539:     // 수능최저DB가 없거나 전형명이 미래 기준과 정확히 일치하지 않아도 입결 사례를 버리지 않습니다.
10540:     // 다만 해당 대학에 수능최저 규칙이 존재하고 현재 성적으로 명확히 미충족인 경우에는 배지를 만들지 않습니다.
10541:     const checks=universityRules.map(rule=>({rule,check:minimumCheck(rule,mockRows)}));
10542:     const anyMet=checks.find(x=>x.check.result==='충족'||x.check.result==='미적용');
10543:     const allDefiniteFail=checks.length>0&&checks.every(x=>x.check.result==='미충족');
10544:     if(allDefiniteFail)continue;
10545:     const fallback=anyMet||checks.find(x=>x.check.result==='판단보류'||x.check.result==='자료부족')||null;
10546:     evidence.push({
10547:       university:String(cut.university||fallback?.rule?.university||''),cut,rule:fallback?.rule||null,limit,actual9:base.actual9,
10548:       minimumResult:fallback?.check?.result||(universityRules.length?'세부확인 필요':'수능최저 직접대응 없음'),
10549:       minimumDetail:fallback?.check?.detail||(cut.minimumLink||'운호고 실제 합격입결 우선 발굴'),mockExam:snapshot.exam||'',mockDetail:snapshot.detail||'',
10550:       pairReason:compatible.length?'2028 전형 큰 범주 연결':'운호고 실제 합격사례 기반 발굴',pairLevel:compatible[0]?.match?.level||1,
10551:       discoveryReason:cut.discoveryReason||'',recheck:cut.recheck||'2029 실제 지원 시 최종 모집요강 재검증',discoveryMode:'입결우선 발굴'
10552:     });
10553:   }
10554:   const best=new Map();
10555:   evidence.forEach(item=>{const key=universityNameKey(item.university),prev=best.get(key);if(!prev||item.pairLevel>prev.pairLevel||(item.pairLevel===prev.pairLevel&&item.limit<prev.limit))best.set(key,item);});
10556:   const result=[...best.values()].filter(item=>universityBadgeVisible(item.university)).sort((a,b)=>universityPriorityIndex(a.university)-universityPriorityIndex(b.university)||String(a.university).localeCompare(String(b.university),'ko'));
10557:   studentBadgeCache.set(cacheKey,result);return result;
10558: }

10634: function studentGrowthMetric(row){

11228:     const reset = $(resetSelector);
11229:     const run = () => {
11230:       const query = (input?.value || "").trim().toLowerCase();
11231:       $$(rowSelector).forEach((row) => {

11235:       });
11236:     };

11238:     if (reset) reset.onclick = () => {
11239:       if (input) input.value = "";
11240:       run();
11241:     };
11242:     return run;
11243:   };

11984: function normalizeAfterAttendanceStatus(value){
11985:   const text=String(value||"").trim();
11986:   if(/불참\(인정\)|공결|공식 ?행사|인정/.test(text))return "불참(인정)";

11988:   if(/불참\(결석\)|병결|결석/.test(text))return "불참(결석)";
11989:   if(/불참\(미인정\)|미인정|무단|불참/.test(text))return "불참(미인정)";
11990:   if(/수강|출석|참여|정상|입실|지각/.test(text))return "수강";
11991:   return "신청";
11992: }

12170: function xmlEscape(value){return String(value??"").replace(/&/g,"&amp;").replace(/</g,"&lt;").replace(/>/g,"&gt;").replace(/\"/g,"&quot;");}

12336: function parseStudentLine(line) {
12337:   const trimmed = String(line || "").trim();
12338:   if (!trimmed) return { number: "", name: "" };
12339:   const parts = trimmed.includes("\t")
12340:     ? trimmed.split(/\t+/)
12341:     : trimmed.includes(",")

12852: async function loadWeather() {
12853:   try {
12854:     const response = await fetch(
12855:       "https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?latitude=36.6424&longitude=127.4890&current=temperature_2m,apparent_temperature,relative_humidity_2m,weather_code,precipitation,wind_speed_10m&hourly=temperature_2m,relative_humidity_2m,precipitation_probability,weather_code,wind_speed_10m&daily=weather_code,temperature_2m_max,temperature_2m_min,precipitation_probability_max&timezone=Asia%2FSeoul&forecast_days=8",
12856:     );
12857:     if (!response.ok) throw new Error("weather unavailable");
12858:     const data = await response.json();
12859:     const now = new Date();
12860:     const currentHour = now.getHours();
12861:     const hourKey = `${now.getFullYear()}-${String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(now.getDate()).padStart(2, "0")}T${String(currentHour).padStart(2, "0")}:00`;
12862:     const currentIndex = Math.max(0, data.hourly.time.indexOf(hourKey));
12863:     weatherState = {
12864:       temp: Math.round(data.current.temperature_2m),
12865:       feels: Math.round(data.current.apparent_temperature),
12866:       code: data.current.weather_code,
12867:       humidity: data.current.relative_humidity_2m ?? 0,
12868:       wind: Math.round((data.current.wind_speed_10m ?? 0) * 10) / 10,
12869:       rain: data.hourly.precipitation_probability[currentIndex] ?? 0,
12870:       precipitation: data.current.precipitation ?? 0,
12871:       daily: data.daily.time.map((time, index) => ({
12872:         time,
12873:         code: data.daily.weather_code[index],
12874:         max: Math.round(data.daily.temperature_2m_max[index]),
12875:         min: Math.round(data.daily.temperature_2m_min[index]),
12876:         rain: data.daily.precipitation_probability_max[index] ?? 0,
12877:       })),
12878:       hourly: data.hourly.time.slice(currentIndex, currentIndex + 8).map((time, offset) => {
12879:         const index = currentIndex + offset;
12906:   if ([71, 73, 75, 77, 85, 86].includes(code))
12907:     return { icon: "🌨️", text: "눈" };
12908:   if ([95, 96, 99].includes(code)) return { icon: "⛈️", text: "뇌우" };
12909:   return { icon: "○", text: "날씨" };
12910: }

15109: function uep08251CampusRegion(segment,name=''){
